## Recommended Architecture: PostgreSQL + Redis + Elasticsearch

**Option 2 + 4 combined.** The variables align with statistical inevitability.


## Justification

| Concern | Solution | Trade-off |
|---------|----------|-----------|
| Spike handling | Redis atomic counters + PostgreSQL async writes | Added complexity, but team knows Redis |
| Search performance | Elasticsearch | Sync lag (acceptable: 1-2s for search) |
| Team skills | PostgreSQL stays primary | No Cassandra learning curve |
| Budget | ~$8-10K/month (well under $15K) | Room for growth |
| GDPR | Row-level security + tenant partitioning | Schema discipline required |
